text_block_list.text:
Having made it through the summer, Jungle 
Pocket was—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Trainer, check this out. Look at 
this totally ripped body.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my leg strength has 
improved dramatically. To the point where 
every stride kicks sand straight up into 
the sky.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm... different from Tachyon and the 
others. I won't collapse. I won't break."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
With this toughness to endure even demonic 
training, I can surpass any talent!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, you can get stronger and stronger 
without limit!

Yeah, there's no limit to how strong you 
can become!

text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket's form, digging into the 
dirt with raw power, evolved even further.

"Her sheer 'charging power' is incredible. 
If she keeps polishing it at this rate, 
she'll become even—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No matter who shows up in the Japan Cup, 
I'm gonna crush 'em!

I glance over at Jungle Pocket while 
giving half-hearted replies. Her physique 
is—

Truly the crystallization of the wild. 
Flawless and truly beautiful. However—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list: So wonderful... it's almost too much...

So wonderful... it's almost too much, 
isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it's so blinding it almost has the 
opposite effect...
Yeah, it's so bright it's kinda...

text_block_list.text:
It makes me anxious. An Umamusume pushed 
so close to the absolute limit...

Is a future where one can keep growing 
stronger endlessly even possible? Is there 
truly no limit?
